title: Public Source Status For Device Safety Data
summary: Major public-source changes this week were limited. Most safety databases available in the app remained reachable in one-request checks on July 24, 2026, with no broad sign of public outages or platform migrations. The main user-visible exception is Brazil, where ANVISA's new public alert consultation experience may still affect how quickly or completely alert records appear in the app.
updates: Brazil ANVISA announced a [new alert consultation tool](https://www.gov.br/anvisa/pt-br/assuntos/noticias-anvisa/2026/anvisa-disponibiliza-nova-ferramenta-para-consulta-de-alertas-sanitarios) on July 6, 2026 that replaced the older Sistec experience. Until the new public access path is fully revalidated, Brazilian alert and recall coverage in the app may be less complete than usual.

FDA posted an [eMDR system enhancement notice](https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/emdr-electronic-medical-device-reporting/emdr-system-enhancements) with scheduled maintenance from July 22, 2026 through July 27, 2026. Public FDA device endpoints remained reachable on July 24, 2026, but very recent MAUDE reports may appear with a short delay during that maintenance window.
no_major_changes: FDA Recall, FDA CDRH Recalls, FDA Safety Communications, BfArM, Swissmedic, MHRA, TGA DAEN, TGA DRAC, Health Canada DHPR, Canada Recall, PMDA, AEMPS, ANSM, and NMPA English showed no significant public setup or access change in this review window.
